editorialRules: One Reel teaches exactly one concept; no multi-topic dumps.
Prefer concrete examples over abstract definitions in the first 8 seconds.
Do not invent API names, version numbers, or benchmark numbers — say 'check docs' if unsure.
Original fiction and mythology framing are out of scope.
Optimize for saves and clarity over controversy bait.
Series episodes must reference series title and part number in packaging.
